resolution.note: prune keeps a worktree whose tip is not the shipped head (reused branch name, open PR); regression in test/hook/stop-merged-lane.test.ts

title: A lane worktree is pruned while its own ship still waits on an open PR
body:
Source: 2026-11-16 lane t-xwfwd2t (branch adopt-canary, PR #1233, commit 00e136b): its worktree disappeared while its own krn pr ship was waiting on the Check; the PR stayed open with auto-merge enabled and merged later as 4d79c48. During that window the lead ran `krn task publish` (merged 34b0681; it prints "the next krn lane start prunes merged lanes") and two `krn lane start` calls (t-6mve9gw, t-g24ccsn lanes). The lane lost its ship verdict and reported a blocker.
Outcome: no krn command removes a worktree whose branch has an open PR or a live ship; the prune names what it removed and why.
Proof: a test drives the prune with an open-PR lane worktree and asserts it survives.
Files: src/cli/lane.ts, src/ci/ship.ts
